messages.quest.last_ember.nether_candle.descripti: Carry the Last Ember study into Nether materials and learn which fires deserve respect.
quest.last_ember.nether_candle.stage.bot: The rods prove the fire. Now bring powder and glowstone dust so the lesson can be held without burning the page.
messages.quest.last_ember.nether_candle.stage.bot: Bring 4 blaze powder for controlled flame.
Bring 8 glowstone dust so the lesson keeps its light.
quest.last_ember.nether_candle.stage.bot: Powder in a bottle is still fire with patience.
Bring 4 blaze powder and 8 glowstone dust for the Nether candle.
The bottled flame can wait until the blaze work is done.
messages.quest.last_ember.nether_candle.stage.bot: Bring 4 blaze powder and 8 glowstone dust.
quest.last_ember.nether_candle.stage.bri: Pearls taught us the shape of looking away. Fire teaches something less polite.
Bring blaze rods, and proof you faced the thing that made them. After that, we bottle the lesson carefully.
Defeat blazes and bring rods. The lesson needs heat that was earned, not stolen from a chest.
messages.quest.last_ember.nether_candle.stage.bri: Bring 2 blaze rods as heat that can be counted.
The blaze threat has been measured.
Defeat 3 blazes for the Nether candle study.
quest.last_ember.nether_candle.stage.bri: Good. Nether work should never begin because someone felt hurried.
Come back with your eyebrows, if you can.
Defeat 3 blazes and bring 2 blaze rods for the Nether candle.
The Nether candle lesson is not open right now.
The Nether candle has already been written.
Defeat 3 blazes and bring 2 blaze rods. Respect the fire, but do not flatter it.
The Nether candle lesson is not ready right now.
messages.quest.last_ember.nether_candle.stage.bri: Defeat 3 blazes and bring 2 blaze rods.
quest.last_ember.nether_candle.stage.ret: This is flame that can be named. Dangerous, but named.
Good. The second note says this: some fires guide, some fires consume, and wisdom starts by knowing the difference.
The Nether candle lesson is still missing something.
Bring the Nether materials here before we seal the lesson.
I cannot close the Nether candle right now.
Keep the powder sealed. Lessons are better when they do not escape.
messages.quest.last_ember.nether_candle.stage.ret: Return with the Nether candle materials.
messages.quest.last_ember.nether_candle.title: The Nether Candle
